title: Test recovery at every effect/checkpoint boundary
prompt: Simulate crash/recovery at before_effect, after_effect, or after_checkpoint for ONE logical operation. Persistent state is modeled by dictionaries outside the restarted worker. Return effect_count and checkpoint_done after recovery. An idempotent mock service prevents duplicate effects; a non-idempotent service demonstrates the after-effect gap. This is a deterministic boundary simulation, not process-crash integration testing.
